description:
Create a GitHub issue for bug reports, feature requests, or feedback.

The issue opens in the taxsort-mcp GitHub repo, prefixed "[Feedback]".
Without an operator GitHub token, a prefilled new-issue link is returned instead.

category.description: One of feedback, bug, feature or question; also becomes a "cat:<category>" label.

contact.description: Optional way to reach the reporter (e.g. an email or Nostr handle), added to the issue body; empty to stay anonymous.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

name: taxsort_create_feedback_issue
title: Send feedback
